correctness.rationale: For each matched pair, N(a_i)=B\{b_i} and N(b_i)=A\{a_i}. Thus every A-side inequality is equivalent to B_f>=2 and every B-side inequality to A_f>=2; parity upgrades the threshold to 2 for even n and 3 for odd n. The enumerators and minimum layer then follow by independent binomial counting on the two sides. Exhaustive enumeration for 3<=n<=8 agrees with every stated coefficient and extremal count.

originality.rationale: The closest primary results determine the scalar signed total domination number for complete bipartite or complete multipartite graphs, while the retained claim is an iff classification and all-weight enumeration for the matching-deleted biclique. Targeted crown/perfect-matching-deletion searches found no statement implying this factorized enumerator or its parity-sensitive deletion comparison. The scalar case n=3 is already covered because Cr_3 is C_6, and scalar minima are not the basis of the originality assessment.

value.rationale: The result is a complete structural classification and exact weight distribution for a canonical matching-deleted biclique, not merely a recomputation of the minimum. The parity-sensitive comparison with K_{n,n} pinpoints exactly when deleting a perfect matching changes every feasible signed-total labeling, giving a natural robustness/boundary statement for an established invariant.
